data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'geile', meaning joy, gladness, or merriment. In Christian tradition, this name represents the joy and gladness of the Lord. The name Geilich carries the meaning “Joyful, glad, merry” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Geilich usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, glad, merry and live with faith, good character and purpose.
